page_title: Cryptomator - Free & Open-Source Cloud Storage Encryption

sources.entry: Cryptomator - Multi-platform transparent client-side encryption of your files in the cloud. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/cryptomator/cryptomator/)

summary.name: Cryptomator
summary.one_liner: Cryptomator is an open-source tool that client-side encrypts files and filenames before they are stored in cloud services such as Dropbox, Google Drive, and OneDrive.
use_cases: Encrypting personal documents and photos stored in Dropbox or Google Drive
Protecting work files in any cloud storage service
Securely sharing vaults with a team using centralized access management
Synchronizing data GDPR-compliant over the cloud with a team when a suitable DPA is in place
Keeping cloud-stored files safe if an account is compromised
summary.what_it_does: Cryptomator encrypts files and filenames with AES using a 256-bit key length before they reach cloud storage. Users unlock encrypted vaults with a vault password, and the files remain protected regardless of where they are stored. The source code is public, and the page says it has independent security audits and automated public testing. Cryptomator Hub is a separate offering for teams, providing centralized access management, zero-knowledge key management, and individual team member accounts for unlocking shared vaults.
notable: Open-source code that anyone can inspect, plus independent security audits
Encrypts both file contents and filenames with AES-256
Cryptomator Hub adds team access management with zero-knowledge key management
Works with any cloud storage service, including Dropbox, Google Drive, and OneDrive
caveats: Team features in Cryptomator Hub are offered as a paid trial/product rather than free; the page mentions a free trial and a discount that varies by region
The page does not state a platform list explicitly; platforms are taken from user comments (Android, Mac, Windows, Linux)
Desktop version is described in a user comment as donation-based (pay what you want)
